scope: Inference-only exploratory Pythia-70M layer index; no model training or official benchmarks
hypothesis: A fixed-probe behavioral sketch preserves exact internal permutation equivalence while predicting heldout response distances better than raw-weight Hadamard coordinates. E8P may reduce descriptor storage.
primary_comparator: Raw-weight neuron-axis Hadamard sketch; full calibration response distances; scalar quantization at matching bit budgets.
primary_metric: Within-layer Spearman rank correlation of calibration descriptor distance with full holdout response distance, noise+checkpoint edits; exact-orbit identity and query retrieval are separately assessed.
success_rule: Advance an unquantized behavioral index if 1024D nearby-edit Spearman >=0.90, all exact query hashes match, maximum exact response relative error <1e-5, and all full-model exact permutations preserve selected top1 predictions.
lattice_adoption_rule: E8P must retain >=99% fractional-tie atlas retrieval accuracy and improve median nearby-edit relative distance error by at least 10% over the same-bit scalar control. Otherwise keep lattice only as a coarse candidate key or reject it.
futility_rule: Stop on model load failure, incoherent permutation fidelity, nonfinite metrics, or 30 minutes of experiment wall time. A failed index metric is a valid negative result, not an execution failure.

design.module: MLP composed with its input LayerNorm; input/output residual basis fixed
design.seed_role: Intervention/permutation seeds, not independent model training seeds
design.noise_definition: Independent Gaussian direction on each MLP matrix, scaled to the stated relative Frobenius norm; biases and layernorm unchanged
design.query: One additional independent exact hidden-neuron permutation for every atlas entry
design.orbit_hash: SHA256 of sorted SHA256 hashes of paired incoming row+bias+outgoing column; fixed global output bias and LayerNorm appended
design.E8P_scope: The paper codebook geometry, applied to behavioral descriptors. No BlockLDLQ, Hessian weighting, weight quantization, or inference acceleration.
design.whole_model: Duplicate; three all-layer MLP permutations; three all-layer head permutations; each layer: seed-73 broken MLP, 5% noise, step64000 MLP+LayerNorm transplant, broken head pairing
design.boundary_rule: No independently permuted residual-stream basis; attention changes only reorder whole heads with coupled QKV and output projection

data.source: 24 original diagnostic prose passages, 12 calibration and 12 holdout, in probes.json
data.split: Separate fixed passages; broad domains shared
data.probe_bank: 128 raw residual states sampled evenly across six layers, separately for calibration/holdout; shared inputs across tested layers
data.tokenization: EOT prefix, at most 127 subsequent tokens per passage
data.prior_exposure: New authored passages; prior Pythia checkpoint study reviewed for conventions only

training.checkpoint_selection: Final step143000 and historical step64000 selected before metrics

evaluation.full_model_nll: All nonpadding next-token targets on 12 holdout passages, natural-log units
evaluation.full_model_kl: Eight deterministic evenly spaced next-token positions per holdout passage, relative to final unmodified checkpoint
evaluation.retrieval: Distinct exact orbit IDs define database labels; ties credited fractionally
evaluation.scaling_claim: none; one architecture and one training trajectory
evaluation.uncertainty: Exploratory, report all intervention seeds and six layers; no population confidence from one model
evaluation.duplicate_policy: One full-model duplicate plus exact permutation cases

execution.concurrent_writers: Unique new branch and run directory; no other worker assigned
